tour_analysis_new_desc: Click this button to create a new analysis: choose the patient, upload the file and start the AI analysis.
tour_analysis_search_desc: Enter the patient's name or passport series. Press the "Search" button to run the search.
tour_analysis_date_desc: Pick a start and end date to see only the analyses uploaded in that period.
tour_analysis_status_desc: The status shows the stage of the AI work: "Waiting" — not sent yet, "AI is analyzing" — in progress, "Ready" — the result is available, "File mismatch" — the wrong file was uploaded, "Error" — a retry is needed.
tour_analysis_ai_desc: Green — normal, yellow — moderate (needs monitoring), red — dangerous (urgent attention). "Not assessed" is shown in grey: the AI gave no level, so a doctor must read the conclusion.
tour_analysis_table_desc: Click a row to open the page with the analysis result, the AI conclusion, recommendations and the PDF download.
tour_analysis_delete_desc: An analysis attached to the wrong patient or created with the wrong file can be deleted. A reason is required — the record is not removed from the database and can be restored if needed.
tour_dash_stats_desc: The large number is today's figure; "Total" below it covers the whole period. Click a card to open the matching list.
tour_dash_menu_desc: The sections are here. The red number next to a menu item is the count of new analyses you have not viewed yet.
tour_dash_lang_desc: The language of the interface and of the AI conclusions: Uzbek, Russian or English. The choice is kept for your next sign-in.
tour_analyzer_patient_desc: Enter the passport series and the date of birth. If the patient is already in the database the fields fill in automatically; otherwise you add them as a new patient.
tour_analyzer_file_desc: The file must match the analysis type. The image must be sharp and legible — a blurry or very small image is rejected. If the type is wrong the AI writes no conclusion and offers to replace the file.
tour_analyzer_doctors_desc: Only the doctors selected here will see the analysis in their cabinet and be able to write a conclusion. If left empty, the analysis appears in nobody's list.
tour_analyzer_complaints_desc: The patient's complaints give the AI context and improve the accuracy of the conclusion. Fill them in whenever possible.
tour_analyzer_submit_title: Step 5: save or run the AI
tour_analyzer_submit_desc: "Save only" — the record is created but the AI is not started (you can send it later). "Analyze with AI" — the file goes to the AI right away and the result is ready within a few minutes.
tour_view_severity_desc: The colour of the AI conclusion: green — normal, yellow — moderate, red — dangerous. If it says "Not assessed", the AI gave no definite level — be sure to read the conclusion.
tour_view_measurements_desc: The values the AI read from the file. They are the basis of the conclusion — if in doubt, compare them with the original file.
tour_view_conclusion_desc: The AI conclusion is a supporting tool — the final diagnosis is made by the doctor. Write your own conclusion here.
tour_view_download_desc: The official document handed to the patient. The QR code on it lets anyone verify the document's authenticity — it protects against forgery.
tour_doctors_add_desc: When you add a staff member they are given a role and sign-in credentials are created.
tour_doctors_roles_desc: Admin and Director see all of the clinic's analyses and manage the staff. A Doctor sees only the analyses assigned to them. A Nurse sees only the ones they created.
tour_patients_search_desc: Search by first name, surname or phone number.
tour_patients_card_desc: Click a row to open all of the patient's analyses (ECG, Holter, ABPM, laboratory, conclusions) in a single chronological list. The passport is not shown in full, for privacy.
tour_card_info_desc: Personal details. The passport series is partly hidden as required for privacy.
tour_card_counts_desc: How many analyses there are of each type. Only the records you are allowed to see are counted.
tour_card_timeline_desc: All analyses in one feed, newest first. Click a row to open the analysis in full.
tour_clinic_main_desc: These details appear in the header of the PDF handed to the patient — fill them in completely and correctly.
tour_clinic_logo_desc: The logo is used in the document header. The licence copy confirms the clinic's right to operate.
tour_clinic_phones_desc: Numbers the patient can call. They are shown in the document as well.

faq_ai_title: Does the AI conclusion replace a diagnosis?
faq_ai_body: No. The AI conclusion is a supporting tool. Only a qualified doctor makes the final diagnosis. That warning is printed on the document as well.
faq_save_title: What is the difference between "Save only" and "Analyze with AI"?
faq_save_body: "Save only" creates the record without starting the AI; you can send it later. "Analyze with AI" sends the file to the AI immediately and the result is ready within minutes.
faq_colors_title: What do the colours in the list mean?
faq_colors_body: Green — normal, yellow — moderate (needs monitoring), red — dangerous (urgent attention). A grey "Not assessed" means the AI gave no definite level, so a doctor must read the conclusion.
faq_mismatch_title: I got a "File mismatch" message. What should I do?
faq_mismatch_body: The uploaded file does not match the selected analysis type (for example, a Holter report uploaded into the laboratory section). In that case the AI deliberately writes no conclusion. Open the analysis and upload the correct file with the "Replace file" button — there is no need to create a new analysis.
faq_quality_title: What should the image be like?
faq_quality_body: The image must be sharp, with legible labels and traces. An image that is too small (under 800×600), blurry or blank is rejected. The file must be no larger than 25 MB.
faq_roles_title: Why can't I see all the analyses?
faq_roles_body: Visibility depends on your role. Admin and Director see all of the clinic's analyses. A doctor sees only the ones assigned to them. A nurse sees only the ones they created. The "Attending doctors" field set when creating the analysis is what decides this.
faq_delete_title: Can a mistakenly created analysis be deleted?
faq_delete_body: Yes, an Admin or Director can delete it. A reason is required. The record is not removed from the database — who deleted it, when and why is kept in the log, and it can be restored if needed.
faq_qr_title: What is the QR code on the document for?
faq_qr_body: The QR code lets anyone verify the document is authentic — that it was produced on the NMED platform. The verification page shows only the patient's initials, not their full details, for privacy.
faq_activation_title: My clinic is not activated. How long does it take?
faq_activation_body: An application is usually reviewed within 1 business day. The review confirms this is a genuine medical facility. You will be notified once it is activated. If it is urgent, contact support with your application number.
